description: 为纯文本模型"看图“设计更好的视觉工具箱和技能，支持多图理解，图片问答，前端UI还原、GUI 自动化等，并可选无缝接入多个主流agent｜ A vision toolkit and skill designed for text-only llms — image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, frontend UI restoration, and GUI automation, with optional seamless integration for Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Oh My Pi, and OpenCode
one_liner: 给纯文本 LLM agent 装上眼睛：图片问答、OCR、截图分析、视觉定位等一套视觉工具箱 + skill，并可无缝接入 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi ｜ Give text-only LLM agents vision: image Q&A, OCR, screenshot understanding, visual grounding, image-to-SVG - a vision toolkit & skill, with drop-in integration for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi
